players.product: InP high-speed response photodiodes (100G and 200G per lane) and monitor photodiodes for optical transceivers

quarterly_data.signal: H1 FY2026 (April-September 2025), with the yen strengthening: sales of high-value products such as optical semiconductors and shaped ACF for camera modules grew, but net sales fell 3.7% to JPY 57,456 million because the prior-year period included phosphor film sales (ended at the end of that half) and a build-up of new automotive ARF deliveries; with higher fixed costs from growth investment centred on optical semiconductors, business profit fell 9.7% to JPY 20,153 million, operating profit fell 14.7% to JPY 19,902 million and profit attributable to owners of parent fell 15.4% to JPY 13,410 million. H1 R&D expense was JPY 3,146 million.
quarterly_data.figure: H1 net sales JPY 57,456 million (-3.7%); business profit JPY 20,153 million (-9.7%); operating profit JPY 19,902 million (-14.7%)

quarterly_data.signal: H1 FY2026 Electronic Materials Components segment: photonics sales rose as shipments of high-speed response photodiodes for optical transceivers and monitor photodiodes for telecommunications equipment expanded; surface-mount fuse sales rose on the production recovery at the main power-tool customer and continued sales for data-center BBUs; ACF sales fell as smartphone trade-in subsidies in China had pulled display ACF demand into the prior fourth quarter. Optical Materials Components: sales JPY 25,351 million (-13.2%), business profit JPY 8,047 million (-19.4%).
quarterly_data.figure: Electronic Materials Components H1 sales JPY 32,510 million (+5.6%), business profit JPY 12,105 million (-1.9%)
